summary: Iteration 148 Testing Complete - Calendar-driven DND Auto-Status Sync. Backend: 20/20 tests passed. All features verified: (1) PUT /api/chat/my-status sets status_manually_set_at (ISO timestamp) in users collection, (2) PUT /api/chat/my-status sets status_auto_dnd=false (Manual-Override), (3) _is_manual() returns True when status_manually_set_at < 24h, (4) _is_manual() returns False when status_manually_set_at > 24h, (5) sync_calendar_dnd() iterates only connected users (chat_ws.connections), (6) sync_calendar_dnd() skips users with manual status set within 24h, (7) sync_calendar_dnd() sets user to dnd + status_auto_dnd=true when _has_active_meeting()=true AND not manual, (8) sync_calendar_dnd() reverts status_auto_dnd=true back to online when _has_active_meeting()=false, (9) _has_active_meeting() considers both host_id meetings and meeting_participants entries, (10) Regression: WS disconnect clears status_manually_set_at and status_auto_dnd, (11) Regression: POST /api/meetings/{id}/ring works, (12) Regression: push_new_chat_message uses bypass_dnd correctly.

test_03_verify_status_manually_set_at_vi.details: status_manually_set_at and status_auto_dnd=false verified via login response

test_05_verify_db_fields_via_python_impo.details: Direct DB access confirms status_manually_set_at (ISO) and status_auto_dnd=false

test_06_is_manual_returns_true_within_24.details: _is_manual() returns True for recently set status

test_09_has_active_meeting_returns_true_.details: _has_active_meeting() returns True for host with active meeting

test_11_sync_calendar_dnd_skips_manual_u.details: sync_calendar_dnd() skipped_manual >= 1 for user with manual status

test_13_sync_calendar_dnd_reverts_auto_d.details: sync_calendar_dnd() reverts to online when no active meeting

test_15_regression_bypass_dnd_in_chat_pu.details: bypass_dnd parameter verified in _eligible_recipients and push_new_chat_message

test_18_code_review_chat_ws_disconnect_c.details: WS disconnect clears status_manually_set_at and status_auto_dnd

calendar_status_is_manual.details: _is_manual() checks if status_manually_set_at is within MANUAL_STICKINESS_HOURS (24h). Returns True if manual, False otherwise.

calendar_status_has_active_meeting.details: _has_active_meeting() checks focus_times, hosted meetings (host_id), and participant meetings (meeting_participants). Returns True if any active meeting window covers now_dt.

calendar_status_sync_calendar_dnd.details: sync_calendar_dnd() iterates only connected users (chat_ws.connections.keys()). Skips manual users, skips in_meeting users. Sets dnd+status_auto_dnd=true when active meeting, reverts to online when no active meeting and was_auto_dnd.

maintenance_integration.details: sync_calendar_dnd imported from services.calendar_status and called in _cleanup_loop_tick between caldav_sync and loop-end.

chat_put_my_status.details: PUT /chat/my-status sets status_manually_set_at=now and status_auto_dnd=false. This marks the status as manually set so calendar-DND auto-sync leaves it alone for 24h.

chat_ws_disconnect.details: WS disconnect finally block sets status_mode='offline', status_manually_set_at=None, status_auto_dnd=False. Clears manual override stickiness on disconnect.

critical_code_review_comments: calendar_status.py correctly implements 24h manual stickiness via MANUAL_STICKINESS_HOURS constant
_has_active_meeting() correctly checks both host_id meetings and meeting_participants entries
sync_calendar_dnd() correctly iterates only connected users (chat_ws.connections.keys())
sync_calendar_dnd() correctly skips users with in_meeting flag set (already handled by _set_user_in_meeting)
PUT /chat/my-status correctly sets status_manually_set_at and status_auto_dnd=false
WS disconnect correctly clears status_manually_set_at and status_auto_dnd
seed_data_creation: Test meetings created during pytest execution, cleaned up after tests
